description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing loan account locks within the Fineract project. It handles HTTP GET requests to list locked loan accounts with pagination support, utilizing annotations for API documentation and dependency injection.

classes.name: LoanAccountLockApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for providing endpoints related to loan account locking, specifically listing locked loan accounts.

methods.name: retrieveLockedAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of locked loan account IDs.
